title: QUIC Zerortt Hosted Proof Gate Verification
verification_method: Requirement-home tests, helper dry-run planning, workflow review, artifact inspection, and hosted workflow dispatch when external evidence is required.
preconditions: The manual hosted workflow retains the advisory zerortt-server-proof profile.
The repo-local interop helper can be executed in dry-run mode.
The preserved hosted artifact bundles for the earlier zerortt attempts remain available for inspection.
scope: Verify that the repository keeps zerortt prerequisite-blocked until hosted Linux packet-analysis proof exists and that partial hosted evidence does not promote the inventory cell.
procedure: Run `dotnet test tests\Incursa.Quic.Tests\Incursa.Quic.Tests.csproj -c Release -m:1 --filter "FullyQualifiedName~REQ_QUIC_INT_0021|FullyQualifiedName~REQ_QUIC_INT_0017|FullyQualifiedName~REQ_QUIC_INT_0018"` and confirm the classification-gate checks pass.

Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\interop\Invoke-QuicInteropRunner.ps1 -DryRun -TestCases versionnegotiation,zerortt,connectionmigration` and confirm zerortt remains prerequisite-blocked in the plan output.

Inspect `.github/workflows/interop-runner-handshake.yml`, `scripts/interop/README.md`, and `scripts/interop/Invoke-QuicInteropRunner.ps1` for the explicit `zerortt-server-proof` advisory profile and blocked-cell wording.
Inspect `specs/requirements/quic/REQUIREMENT-GAPS.md` and `docs/current-status.md` for the remaining-hosted-proof wording.

When external evidence is required, dispatch `gh workflow run interop-runner-handshake.yml --repo incursa/quic-dotnet --ref main -f coverage_profile=zerortt-server-proof` and inspect the preserved runner-report and packet-analysis logs.
expected_result: The repository continues to classify zerortt as prerequisite-blocked until the hosted Linux proof succeeds, and partial hosted proof or server-only dispatch does not promote the inventory cell.
status_summary: Planned for the next proof tail. The repository already has the advisory hosted Linux zerortt-server-proof profile and the helper inventory remains explicit about the remaining packet-analysis blocker. A 2026-05-12 branch rerun on run 25768724412 confirmed the SDK pin to mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0.201 clears the harness image build mismatch and reaches the actual zerortt testcase, but the client still exits with timeout: no recent network activity during file download before packet-analysis promotion can occur. Requirement-home and dry-run proof are expected to keep the cell prerequisite-blocked until a later hosted run produces packet-level 0-RTT success.

supplemental_sections.heading: Deferred Coverage
supplemental_sections.content: `http3` remains out of scope. `chacha20`, `v2`, `rebind-port`, `rebind-addr`, and `connectionmigration` remain separate prerequisite-blocked lanes.
